query:
SELECT
    item_id,
    branch_id,
    SUM(CASE WHEN quantity_available > 0
              AND (expiration_date IS NULL OR expiration_date >= CURDATE())
             THEN quantity_available ELSE 0 END) AS usable_stock,
    SUM(CASE WHEN quantity_available > 0
              AND expiration_date IS NOT NULL AND expiration_date < CURDATE()
             THEN quantity_available ELSE 0 END) AS expired_stock,
    SUM(CASE WHEN quantity_available > 0 THEN quantity_available ELSE 0 END) AS total_stock,
    SUM(CASE WHEN quantity_available > 0
              AND (expiration_date IS NULL OR expiration_date >= CURDATE())
             THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS usable_batches,
    SUM(CASE WHEN quantity_available > 0
              AND expiration_date IS NOT NULL AND expiration_date < CURDATE()
             THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS expired_batches,
    COUNT(*) AS total_batches,
    MIN(CASE WHEN quantity_available > 0 AND expiration_date >= CURDATE()
             THEN expiration_date END) AS nearest_expiration,
    MAX(last_updated) AS last_updated
FROM inventory_stocks
GROUP BY item_id, branch_id
